C065.name: Mtwara Municipal Council
C065.documented: coastal floods, large waves and strong winds, heavy Msimu rain, cholera, and boat accidents

area.en: Mtwara Municipal: Mikindani Bay shore and low streets
area.sw: Manispaa ya Mtwara: ufukwe wa ghuba ya Mikindani na mitaa ya chini

risk.en: This area is a low coastal town where storm tides and erosion attack the shoreline, heavy rain floods low streets and the port and gas facilities bring industrial risk.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa pwani wa chini ambapo mawimbi makubwa na mmomonyoko hushambulia ufukwe, mvua kubwa hufurika mitaa ya chini na bandari na mitambo ya gesi huleta hatari za viwandani.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build back from the shoreline, protect mangroves, keep drains to the sea open and follow safety rules near port and gas installations. What raises the risk: building on the beach front or on filled ground along Mikindani Bay, cutting mangroves for poles, mining sand from the shore and blocking the drains to the sea with waste. Know the higher ground inland that you will move to when a storm-tide or strong-wind warning is given, and go before the tide turns; if an alarm sounds at the port or gas plant, move away upwind as directed and do not go to watch. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe, kulinda mikoko, kuweka mitaro inayoelekea baharini wazi na kufuata kanuni za usalama karibu na bandari na mitambo ya gesi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ufukweni au kwenye ardhi iliyojazwa kando ya Ghuba ya Mikindani, kukata mikoko kwa nguzo, kuchimba mchanga ufukweni na kuziba mitaro inayoelekea baharini kwa taka. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani utakalohamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba au upepo mkali inapotolewa, na ondoka kabla maji ya bahari hayajabadilika; king'ora kikilia bandarini au kwenye mtambo wa gesi, ondoka kuelekea upande ambao upepo unatoka kama unavyoelekezwa na usiende kutazama. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C069.name: Masasi Town Council
C069.documented: wet-season floods, dry-season drought, strong winds, and wildfire

area.en: Masasi Town: inselberg hills and town streams
area.sw: Mji wa Masasi: milima ya mawe na vijito vya mjini

risk.en: This area is a town among rocky inselberg hills where storm run-off rushes off bare rock into streets and seasonal streams, and dry spells cause water shortages.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji uliozungukwa na milima ya mawe ambapo maji ya dhoruba hukimbia kutoka kwenye mawe matupu hadi mitaani na vijito vya msimu, na vipindi vya ukavu husababisha uhaba wa maji.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and stream reserves clear, avoid building at the foot of rock slopes and harvest and store rainwater. What raises the risk: taking up plots at the foot of the inselbergs or inside the stream reserves, and filling the drains with waste. What raises the hardship: letting household water run out before the dry season. Know the higher street away from the stream that you will move to when a storm breaks on the rocks above, and agree early where water will come from when the town supply fails. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na hifadhi za vijito wazi, kuepuka kujenga chini ya miteremko ya mawe na kuvuna na kuhifadhi maji ya mvua. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchukua viwanja chini ya milima ya mawe au ndani ya hifadhi za vijito, na kujaza mitaro taka; kinachoongeza shida: kuacha maji ya kaya yaishe kabla ya kiangazi. Fahamu mtaa wa juu mbali na kijito utakaohamia dhoruba inapoanza kwenye miamba juu yenu, na kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi huduma ya mji ikikosekana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C064.name: Nanyamba Town Council
C064.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, and cholera

area.sw: Mji wa Nanyamba: mashamba ya uwanda wa Makonde

risk.en: This area is on the Makonde plateau where deep groundwater makes water scarce in the dry season and cashew and food crops depend on unreliable rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kwenye uwanda wa Makonde ambapo maji ya ardhini yaliyo chini sana hufanya maji kuwa haba wakati wa kiangazi na korosho na mazao ya chakula hutegemea mvua zisizo za uhakika.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to harvest rainwater, protect water sources and plant drought-tolerant crops with household food reserves. What raises the loss when the rains fail: relying on cashew and maize alone, selling the whole harvest at once, letting the tanks run dry before the dry season and cutting trees for charcoal when money is short. Agree early, as a household and a village, where water and food will come from in a failed season and which wells will be shared; act before the stores are empty, not after. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuvuna maji ya mvua, kulinda vyanzo vya maji na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame na kuweka akiba ya chakula. Kinachoongeza hasara mvua zikikosekana: kutegemea korosho na mahindi pekee, kuuza mavuno yote kwa mara moja, kuacha matanki yakauke kabla ya kiangazi na kukata miti kwa mkaa pesa zinapopungua. Kubalianeni mapema, kama kaya na kijiji, maji na chakula vitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana na visima gani vitashirikiwa; chukueni hatua kabla akiba haijaisha, si baadaye. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C067.name: Newala Town Council
C067.documented: water shortage on the Makonde plateau, heavy rain, and strong winds

area.sw: Mji wa Newala: ukingo wa uwanda wa Makonde

risk.en: This area sits on the Makonde plateau edge, where water is scarce in the dry season and run-off erodes gullies down the escarpment towards the Ruvuma valley.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko ukingoni mwa uwanda wa Makonde, ambapo maji ni haba wakati wa kiangazi na maji ya mvua huchimba makorongo kwenye mteremko kuelekea bonde la Ruvuma.

advice.en: For those living here, it helps to harvest and store rainwater, keep trees and grass on the escarpment and build back from gully edges. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the escarpment face, clearing the last trees from it and tipping waste into the gullies. What raises the hardship: letting the tanks run dry before the dry season. Know the firm ground away from the gully edges that your household will move to when a storm breaks, and agree early where water will come from when the plateau sources fail. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi hapa, ni vyema kuvuna na kuhifadhi maji ya mvua, kuacha miti na nyasi kwenye mteremko na kujenga mbali na kingo za makorongo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye uso wa mwinuko, kukata miti ya mwisho juu yake na kutupa taka kwenye makorongo; kinachoongeza shida: kuacha matanki yakauke kabla ya kiangazi. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na kingo za makorongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia dhoruba inapoanza, na kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi vyanzo vya uwandani vikikosekana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C068.name: Masasi District Council
C068.documented: drought in the dry months, wet-season floods, wildfire, and strong winds

area.en: Masasi DC: farmland and the Lukuledi valley
area.sw: Masasi DC: mashamba na bonde la Lukuledi

risk.en: This area has cashew and food farmland where dry spells damage crops, and the Lukuledi valley where heavy rain floods fields and rural crossings.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya korosho na chakula ambapo vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao, na bonde la Lukuledi ambapo mvua kubwa hufurika mashamba na vivuko vya vijijini.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to plant early-maturing and drought-tolerant varieties, keep food reserves and keep homes and stores off the valley floor. What raises the loss in both wet and dry years: building homes and stores on the Lukuledi valley floor, relying on one crop and selling the whole harvest at once. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the Lukuledi floods the fields and crossings, do not cross the flooded crossings, and agree early where food will come from in a failed season. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mbegu zinazokomaa mapema na kustahimili ukame, kuweka akiba ya chakula na kujenga makazi na maghala nje ya sakafu ya bonde. Kinachoongeza hasara katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na ya ukame: kujenga makazi na maghala kwenye sakafu ya bonde la Lukuledi, kutegemea zao moja na kuuza mavuno yote kwa mara moja. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia Lukuledi inapofurika mashamba na vivuko, msivuke vivuko vilivyofurika, na kubalianeni mapema chakula kitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C063.name: Mtwara District Council
C063.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Mtwara DC: coast, Ruvuma delta and gas fields
area.sw: Mtwara DC: pwani, delta ya Ruvuma na maeneo ya gesi

risk.en: This area includes coastal villages exposed to storm surge and erosion, the Ruvuma delta that floods in wet years, and gas fields such as Msimbati.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha vijiji vya pwani vinavyoathiriwa na mawimbi makubwa na mmomonyoko, delta ya Ruvuma inayofurika katika miaka ya mvua nyingi, na maeneo ya gesi kama Msimbati.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to keep boats ashore in strong winds, keep homes off the delta flood plain and follow safety rules around gas installations. What raises the risk: building on the beach or on the delta flats, cutting mangroves, going out in overloaded boats when the wind is rising and crossing the gas-field exclusion areas. Know the higher ground inland that your village will move to when a storm-surge or strong-wind warning is given, and the raised ground away from the delta for a wet year; go before the tide turns, and if an alarm sounds at the gas plant move away upwind as directed. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuweka vyombo ufukweni wakati wa upepo mkali, kujenga nje ya tambarare ya mafuriko ya delta na kufuata kanuni za usalama karibu na mitambo ya gesi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ufukweni au kwenye tambarare za delta, kukata mikoko, kutoka baharini kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi upepo ukianza kuongezeka na kuvuka maeneo yaliyozuiwa ya gesi. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba au upepo mkali inapotolewa, na eneo lililoinuka mbali na delta kwa mwaka wa mvua nyingi; ondokeni kabla maji ya bahari hayajabadilika, na king'ora kikilia kwenye mtambo wa gesi ondokeni kuelekea upande upepo unakotoka kama mnavyoelekezwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C071.name: Nanyumbu District Council
C071.documented: drought, wildfire, wet-season floods, and human–wildlife conflict on the Mozambican border

area.sw: Nanyumbu: vijiji vya mpakani kando ya mto Ruvuma

risk.en: This area borders the Ruvuma river and Mozambique, where the river floods riverside farms, wildlife raids crops and cross-border movement brings security and disease concerns.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na mto Ruvuma na Msumbiji, ambapo mto hufurika mashamba ya kando ya mto, wanyamapori huvamia mazao na mwingiliano wa mpakani huleta changamoto za usalama na magonjwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes above the river flood line, use community deterrents against wildlife and report unusual illness or insecurity early. What raises the risk: opening fields and building right on the Ruvuma bank, crossing the river in loaded canoes when it is rising and hiding cases of fever, diarrhoea or strangers in the village. Know the higher ground away from the river that your village will move to when the Ruvuma rises, and move before it reaches the fields; report the first unusual illness or security concern to the village leader the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya mstari wa mafuriko ya mto, kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama na kutoa taarifa mapema za magonjwa au hali ya usalama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba na kujenga moja kwa moja kwenye ukingo wa Ruvuma, kuvuka mto kwa mitumbwi iliyojaa unapopanda na kuficha wagonjwa wa homa, kuharisha au wageni wasiojulikana kijijini. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mto ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia Ruvuma inapojaa, na hamieni kabla haijafika mashambani; ripoti ugonjwa usio wa kawaida au hali ya usalama kwa kiongozi wa kijiji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C066.name: Newala District Council
C066.documented: water shortage on the plateau, heavy rain, and strong winds

area.en: Newala DC: plateau villages and Ruvuma valley
area.sw: Newala DC: vijiji vya uwandani na bonde la Ruvuma

risk.en: This area has plateau villages with long walks to scarce water in the dry season and lowland villages in the Ruvuma valley that flood in wet years.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya uwandani vyenye safari ndefu kufuata maji machache wakati wa kiangazi na vijiji vya tambarare katika bonde la Ruvuma vinavyofurika katika miaka ya mvua nyingi.

advice.en: For those living here, it helps to harvest rainwater and protect wells on the plateau, and keep homes and stores above the flood line in the valley. What raises the hardship on the plateau: letting the tanks run dry and fouling the few wells. What raises the risk in the valley: building below the known flood line and crossing the swollen river. On the plateau, agree early where water will come from when the wells fail; in the valley, know the higher ground your household will move to when the Ruvuma rises, and move before it reaches the fields. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi hapa, ni vyema kuvuna maji ya mvua na kulinda visima uwandani, na kujenga makazi na maghala juu ya mstari wa mafuriko bondeni. Kinachoongeza shida uwandani: kuacha matanki yakauke na kuchafua visima vichache. Kinachoongeza hatari bondeni: kujenga chini ya mstari wa mafuriko unaojulikana na kuvuka mto uliojaa. Uwandani, kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi visima vikikosekana; bondeni, fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia Ruvuma inapojaa, na hamieni kabla haijafika mashambani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C070.name: Tandahimba District Council
C070.documented: heavy Msimu rain, floods, dry-season water shortage, and strong winds

area.en: Tandahimba: cashew farmland on the plateau

risk.en: This area is intensive cashew farmland on the plateau where water is scarce in the dry season, crops depend on unreliable rains and dry-season field fires spread.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mashamba mengi ya korosho uwandani ambapo maji ni haba wakati wa kiangazi, mazao hutegemea mvua zisizo za uhakika na moto wa mashamba husambaa kiangazi.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to harvest rainwater, burn fields only under control on calm days and keep household food and cash reserves. What raises the loss: burning cashew fields on windy days or leaving fires unattended, relying on cashew income alone and letting the tanks run dry before the dry season. Know the cleared open ground your household will move to if a field fire spreads towards the houses, and agree early where water and food will come from in a failed season; act before the stores are empty. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kuvuna maji ya mvua, kuchoma mashamba kwa udhibiti siku zisizo na upepo tu na kuweka akiba ya chakula na fedha ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hasara: kuchoma mashamba ya korosho siku za upepo au kuacha moto bila uangalizi, kutegemea mapato ya korosho pekee na kuacha matanki yakauke kabla ya kiangazi. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kaya yako itahamia moto wa shambani ukisambaa kuelekea nyumbani, na kubalianeni mapema maji na chakula vitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana; chukueni hatua kabla akiba haijaisha. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
